نزج (form I)
# نَزُجُّ (nazujju) /na.zud͡ʒ.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of زَجَّ (zajja)
# نُزَجُّ (nuzajju) /nu.zad͡ʒ.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of زَجَّ (zajja)
# نَزُجَّ (nazujja) /na.zud͡ʒ.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of زَجَّ (zajja)
# نُزَجَّ (nuzajja) /nu.zad͡ʒ.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past passive
